name: Swadeza Venture Private Limited
india_angle: Swadeza is showcasing its capabilities at SEMICON India 2026, indicating a strategic focus on the Indian semiconductor market.
summary: Swadeza Venture Private Limited provides an AI-native suite called FORGE, which offers end-to-end workflows for digital verification, physical design, and post-silicon validation in the semiconductor design process. Their solutions are designed to optimize chip design cycles, making them faster and more cost-effective with each iteration.
